a.lede: Leaked private keys for eight CA certificates let any attacker impersonate any domain — billions of older devices and software installations may be vulnerable after round of fixes, patch yours immediately
a.title: Leaked private keys for eight CA certificates let any attacker impersonate any domain

b.lede: Certificate authority eMudhra revoked eight compromised intermediate certificates after researchers found their private keys were so weak that anyone could recover them almost instantly and use them to forge trusted certificates for legitimate websites. [...]
b.title: Mozilla, Google, Apple block compromised eMudhra CA certificates
